title: Overview video
caption: (2 min 39 s, no sound; press play). A rescue robot has to pull a skid out from under a brick structure without dropping it on the people nearby. A video model, language models, a robot policy, a physics engine and NeuWorld are each asked what will happen. NeuWorld then answers a counterfactual, an intervention, a backward question and property inference on the same scene. Then: the rendered channels of the dataset, test scenes across motion families, a scene with the action hidden, video models given the same first frame, and a real recording on a pool table.
source: the paper's teaser video, silent cut v9g (1920 x 1080, 30 fps, H.264, no audio track, encoder tags only)
